citations.excerpt: The Council of Nicaea ( A.D. 325) is an event of the highest importance in the history of Christianity.

citations.locator: Vol. 3, § 119, The Arian Controversy down to the Council of Nicaea, 318–325
citations.excerpt: From the outbreak of the controversy to the temporary victory of orthodoxy at the council of Nicaea; a.d. 318–325.

facts.value: Council called by Constantine that condemned Arius and his teaching.

citations.excerpt: He convened a council, designed to represent the whole Church of the empire, at Nicaea in Bithynia
The deliberations on the Arian question passed through several distinct stages before the final condemnation of Arius and his doctrines was reached.
